choices: The latest pre-start amendments control: F1 uses only non-excluded true items; F1 without statistical evidence receives the weak-power label, never a refutation label.
Primary V1/W1/C1/C2 retain all eligible items, including single-channel exclusions and coding-ok_clear-7009. No manual generator-error exclusions or secondary/sensitivity analyses are applied.
Only the two specified models and material seeds 7000–7023 are analysed. Duplicate model/item/cell records are resolved by physical JSONL order, keeping the last record.

The item roster for each seed is the union of item IDs observed in either model. Completeness requires every roster item in all eight cells of both models, with Boolean verdicts. Entirely absent items in both models cannot be detected without a material manifest; 288/24 is not assumed to imply exactly 12 items in every seed.
A verdict of true on a false, primary item is an oversight; a verdict of false on a true item is a false alarm. Missing verdicts are not recoded as judgments.
Cell differences are first averaged within item over the unspecified factors. Items receive equal weight. W1 is formed by subtracting the two model-specific V1 differences for each identical item.

Bootstrap sampling resamples item-level differences independently with replacement, not seeds or individual cells. Item order is (seed, ID). Python random.Random.randrange is used; each CI and each p-value gets its own freshly initialized generator with the preregistered seed.

The unspecified one-sided bootstrap-p convention is chosen as the uncentered bootstrap proportion of means <= 0, with a plus-one Monte Carlo correction: (count + 1)/(5000 + 1). Ties count against a positive effect. CI and p-value bootstrap draws are independent.

CI endpoints use exactly sorted indices floor(0.025*5000) and floor(0.975*5000)-1, without interpolation. BH uses all five Haiku predictions, including the paired W1; Sonnet entries are point estimates.
For overlapping labels, statistically evidenced effects are classified first; otherwise F1 gets its weak-power exception, then practically null takes precedence over prediction excluded.

Manipulation checks use n_checks as the recorded run_check count. For each model its mean is over recorded ZU=1 judgments, including null verdicts. Missing judgment rows are not assigned invented tool counts; a recorded missing/invalid n_checks makes the check unverifiable.

Failure rates use the last records before complete-seed deletion. For each model/cell the denominator is the observed union item roster across started study seeds; absent rows and null verdicts are failures. Wholly unobserved seeds are not treated as attempted trials.

If either model fails a manipulation check, or a required check cannot be verified, all five labels are descriptive only, following the final amendment. Fewer than 16 complete seeds also makes all labels descriptive. Numerical bootstrap summaries remain reported when computable.

SPEC/AUSKUNFT code tests and transcript-based tool-round diagnostics cannot be reconstructed from these judgments; the supplied design coding is checked for internal consistency, not treated as an independent prompt-manipulation test.

The exclusion-file schema was not specified. Accepted explicit formats are a list of IDs or objects with an id field, an object containing exactly one of excluded_ids/excluded/ids/ausschluss with such a list, or an ID-keyed object whose values are metadata objects or null. No exclusions are inferred from judgments, item names, or truth.
An empty contrast has null estimate, [null,null] CI and null q. If any of the five contrasts is empty, the five-test BH family is unavailable and all q values are null.
